description: Papers, preprints and patents from OpenAlex, arXiv, PubMed and Europe PMC in one deduplicated list, newest first or most influential first: title, abstract, authors and affiliations, venue, DOI, PDF link, citations, citations per year, field-normalized impact (top 1% / 10%), open-access status, and for patents the number, applicants and IPC/CPC classes. Retracted papers are left out. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/research-radar on your Apify account (about $0.003 per result; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 30, max 500). Cost scales with this.

open_access_only.description: Only papers that are free to read.

posted_within_days.description: Only results published in the last N days.

queries.description: Topics, keywords or phrases, e.g. "solid state battery".

sort_by.description: newest first, most cited, or highest field-normalized impact (influential work).

sources.description: Which sources to search. Default: openalex, arxiv, pubmed, europepmc, patents.

name: search_research

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search papers, preprints and patents
